628:t_1:3.en: ～$$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace　$$霊子吸収システム$$～

628:t_1:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What have you found, Dr. $$トライア$$?」

628:t_1:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Its structure is the same as the $$霊子吸収システム$$ we saw on $$翠の地球$$. Its scale is extraordinary, though.」

628:t_1:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「It seems the people supplying spirit quanta were divided into groups of 50,000, rotating every three days.」

628:t_1:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「How did that rotation work?」

628:t_1:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Spirit quanta, the power of life... In other words, biological energy is theoretically inexhaustible as long as a person is alive.」

628:t_1:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「So the Empire would let people rest once they were heavily depleted, and use other people until they recovered.」

628:t_1:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So this system kept selected people in service for a long time, rather than treating them as disposable...」

628:t_1:11.en:
$$田中司令$$
「That's why all the VIPs survived, then.」

628:t_1:12.en:
$$トライア$$
「Unlike $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, it also has the advantage of an extremely low risk of running wild, since human will controls the $$次元力|lc$$.」

628:t_1:13.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As a system, we could call it fully developed. But...」

628:t_1:14.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Considering the people deprived of their freedom and exposed to mortal danger, this facility should never be used again.」

628:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...I'm glad you're all safe.」

628:t_1:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Once we in $c have completed the essential investigation, we will leave $$ラース・バビロン$$ immediately.」

628:t_1:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$地球連邦軍$$ will take you into their protection after that.」

628:t_1:19.en:
$$カガリ$$
「So the $$連邦軍$$ have been fighting all this time too.」

628:t_1:22.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Are you pursuing the Imperial forces that left Earth?」

628:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That isn't our objective, but...」

628:t_1:24.en:
$$カガリ$$
「No... I don't mean to interfere with military affairs. But please let me say this.」

628:t_1:25.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Thank you, $c... I am grateful for everything you have done up to today.」

628:t_1:26.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It isn't over yet. We will keep fighting until peace has fully returned to both Earths.」

628:t_1:27.en:
$$マリナ$$
($$刹那$$... So I won't be able to see you...)

628:t_1:29.en:
$$マリナ$$
「You're... You helped $$オーブ$$ before...」

628:t_1:30.en:
$$シン$$
「My name is $$シン・アスカ$$.」

628:t_1:31.en:
$$シン$$
「$$刹那$$ went to see a friend who was among the captives, so I came to greet you in his place, Princess $$マリナ$$.」

628:t_1:32.en:
$$マリナ$$
「I'm sorry to trouble you when you're so busy.」

628:t_1:33.en:
$$シン$$
「Um... About $$刹那$$... He's pretty unfriendly and hard to figure out, but...」

628:t_1:34.en:
$$シン$$
「He treasures the flowers you gave him in $$オーブ$$, Princess $$マリナ$$. I... just wanted to tell you that...」

628:t_1:35.en:
$$マリナ$$
「Thank you. That makes me very happy.」

628:t_1:36.en:
$$マリナ$$
($$刹那$$... You accepted my hopes for peace.)

628:t_1:37.en:
$$マリナ$$
(Even if we follow different paths, you and I wish for the same thing... I believe the day will come when we understand each other.)

628:t_1:39.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ won't come, however long you wait.」

628:t_1:40.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「That voice... You're $$ヒイロ・ユイ#pilot$$, aren't you?」

628:t_1:41.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You remembered me, even though I wasn't at $$アッシュフォード学園$$ for very long...」

628:t_1:42.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「You had a very distinctive air about you. And I could never forget that gentle voice.」

628:t_1:43.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's the first time anyone's said that to me.」

628:t_1:44.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「You're fighting alongside $$ゼロ$$ too, aren't you, $$ヒイロ$$?」

628:t_1:45.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「He's busy too. $$カレン$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$, and $$スザク$$ are helping him, so they can't come here either.」

628:t_1:46.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「...You really are kind, $$ヒイロ$$.」

628:t_1:47.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「But it's all right. I... understand what $$ゼロ$$ is thinking too.」

628:t_1:48.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It seems my concern was unnecessary.」

628:t_1:49.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「No... With someone like you by $$ゼロ$$'s side, $$ヒイロ$$, I have nothing to worry about or fear.」

628:t_1:50.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「Please tell him that I too will do everything I can to help rebuild Earth.」

628:t_1:51.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I understand. $$ゼロ$$ will keep fighting to protect the world you want as well.」

628:t_1:52.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... The same goes for me...)

628:t_1:53.en:
$$カガリ$$
「...Is that you, Ensign $$リディ$$?」

628:t_1:54.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's been a while, Representative $$アスハ$$.」

628:t_1:55.en:
$$カガリ$$
「You've changed quite a bit since I last saw you...」

628:t_1:56.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's all the result of my own actions.」

628:t_1:57.en:
$$リディ$$
「Looking back, I behaved disgracefully in front of you in $$オーブ$$ too, Representative. I've come to apologize for that.」

628:t_1:58.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Please don't worry about it. I'm still grateful to you for fighting to protect $$オーブ$$, Ensign.」

628:t_1:59.en:
$$カガリ$$
「And when I said you'd changed, I meant it in a good way.」

628:t_1:61.en:
$$カガリ$$
「At least compared to when you seemed angry at everything in $$オーブ$$, your eyes now look like those of someone who knows what they must do.」

628:t_1:63.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I'm hardly someone who has the right to lecture you, Ensign, though.」

628:t_1:64.en:
$$カガリ$$
「And I know that was an irresponsible thing to say, since I don't even know what happened to bring you to this point.」

628:t_1:65.en:
$$カガリ$$
「But, Ensign... If we can't return to the past, let's do what we can for the future.」

628:t_1:66.en:
$$リディ$$
「Thank you, Representative. I'm glad I was able to see you here today.」

628:t_1:67.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Tell $$シン$$, $$キラ$$, and the others that I'll do my best too, so they mustn't give up.」

628:t_1:68.en:
$$リディ$$
「Understood. Then I'll be on my way.」

628:t_1:69.en:
$$カガリ$$
(Captain $$ブライト$$ told me about $$クロノ$$...)

628:t_1:70.en:
$$カガリ$$
(I carried on my father's wishes and became $$オーブ$$'s representative. If you reject your father's ways, Ensign, I hope you can forge a better path yourself.)

628:t_1:74.en: ～Inside the $$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace～

628:t_1:76.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You felt it too, $$マリー$$. Something strange about this building.」

628:t_1:79.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ティエリア$$ suspects it's one of the measures meant to ensure complete isolation from the outside.」

628:t_1:80.en:
$$マリー$$
「Could the people gathered here be...」

628:t_1:81.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Yes. Apparently many have the potential to become $$ニュータイプ$$s, $$イノベイター$$s, or psychics.」

628:t_1:82.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$刹那$$ also found someone he knew on the list and went to talk to them, I hear.」

628:t_1:83.en:
$$タケル$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$, please come with me to the hangar in Block 8...!」

628:t_1:85.en:
$$タケル$$
「An unidentified enemy has infiltrated this facility.」
